items.text: June 3: Idea re: Blackshard Armour/fireglaive combo. Having access to a native 3+ to shooting (if you also bring the shield) is pretty rare for a core troop option. It also allows them to use the fire glaive in combat and get a 4+ save, giving it an edge over the GW. You can also still bring the shield and go HW/Shield in combat for a defensive stance, whereas you would be limited to a 5+ save with GW. This to me provides a nice trade off rather than making the GW+Blackshard combo a no brainer. I think it also represents the actual models the best too, because the Infernal guard were only ever available as HW/Shield or Fireglaive. So that’s the rationale.
